purpose: Non-destructive syllabus mapping of the 38 proposed replacement questions. This file does not authorize insertion, CSV edits, publication, PR merge or production deployment.
source_policy: Use JAMB's IBASS syllabus as the primary reference. The official Mathematics PDF endpoint was not extractable in this audit session; Mathematics mappings remain provisional and must be checked against the live IBASS document. For every subject, confirm the current IBASS revision before publication.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.syllabus_area: Geometry/Trigonometry — Euclidean geometry
items.rationale: The rectangle-diagonal property is a plane-geometry property.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.syllabus_area: Organic chemistry — alkanoic acids and esterification
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly includes esterification among alkanoic-acid reactions.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Simple A.C. circuits
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly covers A.C. current and voltage, peak and r.m.s. values.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Heredity — inheritance of characters
items.rationale: Dominant/recessive allele expression is within inheritance and cross-breeding concepts.

items.subject: Literature in English
items.syllabus_area: Poetry — types of poetry (elegy)
items.rationale: Not cleared for insertion: the mapped elegy replacement draft duplicates the concept already tested by batch 14, row 38 ('An elegy is a poem traditionally written to:').

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Reproduction — sexual reproduction in flowering plants
items.rationale: Seed dispersal by hooks/barbs is related to fruit/seed biology, but seed-dispersal mechanisms are not expressly named in the accessible syllabus text.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Heat transfer
items.rationale: Radiation is expressly listed as a mode of heat transfer.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.syllabus_area: Acids, bases and salts — indicators
items.rationale: Acid/base indicators are expressly included.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.syllabus_area: Electrolysis — electrolysis of dilute sulphuric acid
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly lists electrolysis of dilute H2SO4; the role of ions in conductivity is within this topic.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: Money and inflation — deflation
items.rationale: Deflation, its measurement, effects and control are expressly listed.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Refraction of light through plane and curved surfaces — lenses
items.rationale: The syllabus includes types of lenses and lens formula; the optical-centre ray rule is a supporting lens principle.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: National income — measurement and estimates
items.rationale: Per-capita income is a national-income estimate/measure and fits this topic.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.syllabus_area: Organic chemistry — alkanes and substitution reactions
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly includes substitution/halogenation reactions of alkanes.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Variety of organisms — living organisms and cell structure; Monera/prokaryotes
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly identifies Monera as prokaryotes and covers cell structure.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: Public finance — public expenditure
items.rationale: Teacher salaries fit public expenditure; the specific recurrent-versus-capital classification is not expressly named in the accessible topic list.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.syllabus_area: Separation of mixtures and purification of chemical substances
items.rationale: Separating immiscible liquids is an application of separation methods; the separating-funnel apparatus is not specifically named.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Coordination and control — plant hormones/phytohormones
items.rationale: Auxins and their effects on growth and tropism are expressly included.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Reflection of light at plane and curved surfaces
items.rationale: The laws of reflection are expressly listed.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: International trade — trade arrangements/customs unions
items.rationale: A customs union is a regional trade arrangement; the term itself is not expressly named in the accessible syllabus text.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: Financial institutions — deposit money banks and creation of money
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly includes deposit money banks and the creation of money.

items.subject: Literature in English
items.syllabus_area: Drama — dramatic techniques
items.rationale: Flashback is expressly listed as a dramatic technique.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Transport — blood, lymph and media of transportation
items.rationale: The syllabus expressly covers blood composition/functions and media of transportation.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: International trade / economic growth and development — foreign investment
items.rationale: Foreign direct investment is related to international capital flows and development, but FDI is not expressly named in the accessible syllabus text.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Variety of organisms — Monera/prokaryotes and bacteria
items.rationale: Bacteria/prokaryotes are expressly included; peptidoglycan composition is a supporting structural detail not separately named.

items.subject: Economics
items.syllabus_area: Public finance — taxation and tax principles
items.rationale: Taxation is expressly included; the specific term tax evasion is not expressly listed in the accessible topic text.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Capacitors
items.rationale: Capacitance and numerical problems involving capacitors are expressly included.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.syllabus_area: Algebra — variation (joint variation)
items.rationale: Joint variation is expressly part of the variation topic.

items.subject: Government
items.syllabus_area: Arms of government — legislature; structures of governance — federalism; constitution
items.rationale: Legislative powers and the federal structure are directly covered by the syllabus topics.

items.subject: Use of English
items.syllabus_area: Lexis and structure — ordinary/idiomatic usage and word classes/functions
items.rationale: The preposition collocation is a standard usage/lexis item within this section.

items.subject: Use of English
items.syllabus_area: Lexis and structure — synonyms and word meaning
items.rationale: Confirmed semantic duplicate. Both items test the meaning of the same vocabulary word, meticulous; adding a sentence context does not make it a distinct question-bank concept.

items.subject: Physics
items.syllabus_area: Mechanics — Newton's laws, impulse and momentum
items.rationale: Impulse and momentum are expressly listed under Newton's laws of motion.

items.subject: Literature in English
items.syllabus_area: General literary principles — literary terms and figures of speech
items.rationale: Confirmed semantic duplicate. Both items test euphemism: a mild expression substituted for a harsh/direct expression. The example “passed away” is simply an instance of the same concept.

items.subject: Use of English
items.syllabus_area: Lexis and structure — word classes/functions and clause patterns
items.rationale: The possessive relative pronoun is a grammar/word-function item within this section.

items.subject: Use of English
items.syllabus_area: Lexis and structure — number and agreement/concord
items.rationale: Agreement/concord is expressly listed.

items.subject: Literature in English
items.syllabus_area: General literary principles — literary terms
items.rationale: Epigraph is a literary term, but it is not individually named in the accessible list; confirm that this extension is acceptable before insertion.

items.subject: Government
items.syllabus_area: Political parties and party systems — organization and functions
items.rationale: Political-party organization is expressly listed.

items.subject: Government
items.syllabus_area: Arms of government — legislature; processes of legislation
items.rationale: A private member's bill is a legislative process, but the specific term is not expressly named in the accessible topic list.

items.subject: Biology
items.syllabus_area: Humans and environment — disease prevention/vaccination; reproduction and development
items.rationale: Maternal antibody transfer/passive immunity is not expressly named in the accessible syllabus text; subject-expert confirmation is required.

release_gate: Do not insert any replacement until the user explicitly approves the 38-row retain/replace register, all subject-review-required items are cleared, and every draft passes contextual full-bank duplicate review. Blocked items must be re-drafted before insertion. All questions remain draft until normal academic review and approval.
